title: Prescription and pharmacy requirements not applicable.
bodyText: Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, the prescription requirements of section 329-38 and the board of pharmacy licensure or regulatory requirements under chapter 461 shall not apply to the medical use of cannabis under this part.
bodyHtml: [§329-131]  Prescription and pharmacy requirements not applicable.  Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, the prescription requirements of section 329-38 and the board of pharmacy licensure or regulatory requirements under chapter 461 shall not apply to the medical use of cannabis under this part. [L 2015, c 241, pt of §5; am L 2017, c 170, §2]
